execution.description: Gave the phase-4 Attacker its model's whole context through GRAPHITE-D34's role-keyed MODEL_SETTINGS, and printed the recorded selection in the phase-4 dry run and prelive.

expected: The Attacker joins D34's table with no new mechanism, and the run's 1.93 token allowance still holds at least one full reservation on its starting model.
observed: One role entry was enough: AttackerProvider already selects through GraphiteProvider._selection on engy-chat. On glm-5.2 a call now reserves 0.18132992 (0.04763648 before), so the allowance holds ten full reservations instead of forty; one kimi-k3 call (2.0646912) exceeds it, so a session on that rung stops run_cap_reached before its first call.
keep: Settings keyed by role and frozen in the session record: a new role joins with one entry, and a recorded session resumes with what it recorded.
Print the recorded selection, with the reservation per call against the token allowance, in the dry run and the pre-live gate before any spend.
change: When a role gets a live session path, decide its model settings before its first live session, and check its top rung's whole-window reservation against its token allowance.
